acceptanceCriteria: the dispute is settled by an owner-accepted spec amendment or decision, and any resulting fix lands with a regression test
body: Filed 2026-09-25 from the pre-1.0 expert panel review, main report §4 Disputed findings (scratchpad review/out/panel-report.md). Both verifiers confirmed the code facts; they split on whether the behaviour is a defect or an accepted documented choice. Owner instruction 2026-09-25: known issues are addressed before the next release. Settle the split (spec amendment or fix) as the finding's own 'Settles it' text says, then fix or record the accepted choice. Finding text: Core host adapters cannot be installed from the Core release artifact (landscape high; 1/2). Agreed: the native archive builds `./cmd/corvint` plus legal files only; no plugin tree is embedded; the trees ship only in the companion bundle, which INSTALL.md calls planned and macOS-only. Split: HLQ-V1-001 installs from a source checkout, and no requirement says the archive must carry the trees. Settles it: the owner states whether "Core" plugin trees must be installable from the Core artifact. If yes, ship the trees in the archive with an `adapter install` verb; if no, the 1.0 spec should say the Core host rows require a source checkout.
title: panel D15: Core host adapters cannot be installed from the Core release artifact
